palette: obsidian black-green, glacial mint, amber seal, wine ribbon, frost silver, bone paper
typography: obsidian-hall headings on glacial rail tabs, bone chips and amber wax verdicts
composition: an obsidian hall where classification pairs sit across an axis, the entitled-unentitled fork carries defence claims, protection flows split by claimant identity, and return lanes run A A-plus-a and A-minus-a ledgers
surface: bone paper files, glacial desk rails, wine ribbon tags, amber wax seals
motion: possession chips snap into controlling hands then vanish when the hand lets go, a claim ribbon ties the shared right to its unit as it travels, protection arrows change colour by who strikes whom, and return ledgers weigh善意 against恶意 before settling amounts
transition: the obsidian hall floor, glacial rails and amber seal posts persist while axes, forks, flows and ledgers are re-dressed between scenes
